描述_ZN: The Banquet in the Garden of Ten Thousand Trees" scroll, Qianlong, Qing dynasty, painted by Lang Shining and others, on silk with color, 221.2 cm long and 419.6 cm wide.　　In the winter of 1753, one of the four parts of Erut Mongol, the Dulbert Department, led by its chief Che Ling, Che Ling Ubash, Che Ling Mengke (historically known as the three Che Ling) three Taiji, more than 3,000 households and more than 10,000 people left the nomadic Erskine River for many years and defected to the Qing court jurisdiction of Uliasutai. The Qianlong emperor knew that their attachment to the Qing dynasty has a positive role in the unification of the nationalities, and also has a not to be underestimated impact on the stabilization of the war-torn Mongolian Junggar Department, so they were ennobled Prince, County King, Baylor and other titles, and rewarded a lot of gold and silver, jade, porcelain, silk and other items, and in May of the 19th year of the Qianlong era (1754), held a grand banquet in the summer resort of Wanshuyuan, to them A warm reception was given to them. The court painter Lang Shining and others were instructed to depict the banquet in a documentary manner, and his painting "The Banquet in the Garden of Ten Thousand Trees" is a true reproduction of this event of national unity.
